rules.label: CPF
rules.notes: Eleven digits. Two check digits. A number of all the same digit is not a CPF. The dotted form is found without a label. An unformatted number needs a nearby label.

rules.label: CNPJ
rules.notes: Fourteen digits. Two check digits. A number of all the same digit is not a CNPJ. The printed form is found without a label. An unformatted number needs a nearby label.
